newsitem.title: USA: Autotote says signs $5.5 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Autotote says signs $5.5 mln contract.

text.p: Autotote Corp said Tuesday its Autotote Systems subsidiary signed a $5.5 million contract to sell equipment to Jockey Club del Peru.

Autotote said that under the contract, it will provide the central operating system hardware and software, 500 Probe terminals, an infield board and related equipment for the Hipodromo de Monterrico racetrack and the Jockey Club's off- track betting network.

The company said Jockey Club, which purchased Autote equipment in 1981, plans to use the new products to expand its off-track-betting network from 55 locations to 300 locations within a year, with possible expansion to 500 locations and 1,000 terminals within two years.
The company said Jockey Club will also use the system to provide services for other regional racetracks and to develop and administer a lottery.
The company said it expects to ship the equipment in the fourth quarter of 1997.
